consumed.use: Confined the lead's open post-barrier sink-cycle candidate to the new bounded-incomparability/variance exceptional class.
Refined its >80/81 shallow-cut mixture: every residual state is induced and hence has width<=3 and pi<K_*^2, with exact inherited weights retained.

main_result.rank_atom: If beta<1/3 and width(P)<=3, q(x)>= (1-2 beta)^9 > 3^-9 for every x.
main_result.range_band: Let K_* be any Aires-Kahn Theorem 3.1 threshold for mu=1,L=387420488. Any POS3 counterexample satisfies 7<=pi(P)<K_*^2.
main_result.threshold_caveat: K_* is source-existential; no numerical value is asserted.

actual_law_guard: No residual/deletion law was replaced by a uniform surrogate. The remaining transport problem must retain exact conditional weights or first prove a comparison bound.
first_unpaid_implication: Bounded-range shallow-mixture transport/selection under exact inherited weights, compatible with the lead's POS3-POST-BARRIER-SINK-CYCLE-v1 route.
